data.summary: Result-driven Network Engineer with 7.5+ years of experience in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting large-scale enterprise and cloud network infrastructures. Strong expertise in Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, L2VPN, L3VPN, VPLS, MP-BGP) and data center networking (Leaf-Spine architecture). Hands-on experience in Palo Alto firewall administration, security policy design, NAT, and VPN solutions. Proficient in cloud networking (AWS & OCI), including VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity. Skilled in network automation using Python and delivering 99.99% uptime for mission- critical environments.

Strong expertise in Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, L2VPN, L3VPN, VPLS, MP-BGP) and data center networking (Leaf-Spine architecture). raw_sections.skills: KEY SKILLS • Routing & Switching: BGP, OSPF, MPLS, L2VPN, L3VPN, MP-BGP, STP, VLAN, VTP, EtherChannel, HSRP, VRRP • Data Center Networking: Core/Aggregation/Access Switches, Leaf-Spine Architecture, EVPN, ECMP, High Availability, Capacity Planning, Network Migrations • Network Automation: Python, Configuration Templates, Automated Health Checks, Compliance Audits • Network Security: Palo Alto NGFW, Palo Alto Panorama, NAT, VPN, Security Policies, Threat Analysis, Rule Optimization • • AWS Networking & Cloud Services: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, NACL, Security Groups, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Elastic IP, VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN, Route 53, CloudFront, Global Accelerator, Elastic Load Balancer (ALB/NLB), VPC Endpoints, AWS Private Link, Network Firewall, Transit Gateway Peering, Hybrid Cloud Connectivity, Multi-Account Networking, Multi-Region Architecture, Network Security, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Cloud Migration, Monitoring and Troubleshooting. Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Global Accelerator, CloudFront, ELB • Oracle Cloud Networking (OCI): VCN, DRG, Fast Connect, Route Tables, Service Gateways, Security Lists, Hybrid Connectivity • Network Tools & Platforms: Slack, ServiceNow, Jira, SolarWinds, Grafana, Prometheus, Wireshark, SNMP Monitoring • Vendors & Hardware: Juniper, Arista, Cisco, Palo Alto Operational Excellence: Incident/ Problem Management, RCA, Maintenance Windows, SLA Compliance

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE NETWORK ENGINEER | ORACLE TECHNOLOGIES INDIA PVT LTD (OCI)
Bangalore | Feb 2024 – April 30th 2026
Managed and maintained OCI network infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance across large-scale production environments by continuously monitoring network health and proactively addressing potential issues • Troubleshot complex L2/L3 issues (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPNs) by analyzing routing tables, logs, and packet ^lows to quickly identify root causes and restore services • Handled P1/P2 critical incidents, coordinating with cross-functional teams and performing detailed RCA to minimize downtime and prevent recurrence • Worked on Leaf-Spine architecture with ECMP routing, ensuring efficient traffic distribution and optimized East-West data center traffic is low • Collaborated with multi-vendor environments (Cisco, Juniper, Arista) to resolve interoperability issues and maintain seamless network operations • Improved operational efficiency through proactive monitoring and issue resolution, reducing incident
Managed Oracle Cloud networking components, including VCNs, DRGs, Fast Connect, Route Tables, Service Gateways, Security Lists, and hybrid connectivity solutions between cloud and on-premises environments.

Executed network maintenance activities, software upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure expansion projects during scheduled maintenance windows while ensuring minimal customer impact and service continuity.
